title: Settings
subtitle: Manage indexing and privacy settings
excludePatternsDesc: File paths matching these patterns will be skipped
excludePatternGuide: Use glob paths. Matching files are not indexed and are not sent to the model.
redactRulesDesc: Matched content will be replaced with the specified text
redactRuleGuide: Use a regular expression to match sensitive text, then choose what the model sees instead. Built-in rules already cover email, IPv4, and common keys.
ruleNameHelp: A short label shown in this table.
rulePatternHelp: Rust regex. Match only the sensitive part.
windowCloseBehaviorDesc: Choose whether the close button quits Nexa or keeps it available from the system tray.
windowCloseExitDesc: Close the window and stop all background activity.
windowCloseTrayDesc: Hide the window while Nexa keeps running in the background.
embeddingModelLightDesc: ~46 MB, 384-dim, 50+ languages. Fast, good for most use cases.
embeddingModelBestDesc: ~614 MB INT8, 1024-dim, 100+ languages and long context. Best local retrieval quality.
embeddingModelChangeWarning: Switching models requires re-downloading and re-embedding all data.
embeddingTfidfWarning: TF-IDF only performs keyword matching with no semantic understanding
embeddingProviderChangeWarning: Switching providers requires re-embedding all documents
documentToolsDesc: Python-backed Office workflows for creating, reading, editing, and converting Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF files.
documentToolsPythonMissing: Python was not found. Install Python 3, then run Prepare again
modelsDesc: Manage AI models for search, OCR, and speech recognition
modelsEmbeddingDesc: Vector search model for finding relevant content
modelsOcrDesc: Text recognition model for extracting text from images
modelsWhisperDesc: Whisper model for transcribing audio and video
networkMirrorsDesc: Fallback URLs used when upstream hosts are unreachable.
hfMirrorHint: Used as fallback when huggingface.co is blocked. Empty = disabled.
ghproxyHint: Used as fallback for built-in GitHub downloads such as OCR and FFmpeg. Empty = disabled.
webSearchDesc: No-key public search routing, reranking, and provider health.
webSearchProfile.default.desc: Fast language-aware built-in routing. No API key required.
webSearchProfile.free.desc: Same zero-setup native providers as default, kept explicit for profile presets.
webSearchProfile.free_verified.desc: Queries more no-key providers for cross-source diversity before ranking.
webSearchProfile.max_evidence.desc: Uses every built-in no-key provider for broader evidence at higher latency.
webSearchReranker.auto.desc: Chooses docs, research, or news ranking from the query and freshness window.
webSearchReranker.docs_first.desc: Prioritizes official documentation, API references, and developer pages.
webSearchReranker.research.desc: Prioritizes papers, institutional domains, and scholarly sources.
webSearchReranker.news_balanced.desc: Balances recency-oriented reports across recognized news domains.
webSearchProviderMode.built_in_first.des: Use zero-setup native search first, then configured providers when more evidence is needed.
webSearchProviderMode.custom_first.desc: Use configured providers first and keep native search as fallback.
webSearchCustomProvidersDesc: Enable common presets. Fill API keys where required; AnySearch can run anonymously and SearXNG needs an instance URL.
webSearchCustomProvider.brave.desc: API-key preset using Brave's web search endpoint.
webSearchCustomProvider.tavily.desc: API-key preset optimized for agent research snippets.
webSearchCustomProvider.anysearch.desc: Unified AI search endpoint. API key is optional; empty uses anonymous quota.
webSearchCustomProvider.serpapi_google.d: API-key preset for Google results through SerpAPI.
webSearchCustomProvider.searxng.desc: Self-hosted or trusted SearXNG instance with JSON search enabled.
ocrEnabledDesc: Extract text from images and scanned PDFs using PaddleOCR
ocrConfidenceDesc: Minimum confidence to accept OCR results (0.0–1.0)
ocrLlmFallbackDesc: Use LLM Vision API when OCR confidence is low
ocrDetLimitDesc: Maximum image dimension for text detection (pixels)
videoEnabledDesc: Extract text from video files using FFmpeg + Whisper speech-to-text
videoTranscriptionModeDesc: Reuse Voice Input, use the local Whisper model, or disable media transcription.
videoFailurePolicyDesc: Choose whether visual and metadata indexing can continue without a transcript.
videoFfmpegHint: FFmpeg is required for video processing. Install it from ffmpeg.org or download it automatically.
videoModelTinyDesc: Fastest, basic accuracy. Good for quick processing.
videoModelBaseDesc: Good balance of speed and accuracy. Recommended.
videoModelLargeDesc: Most accurate model, requires substantial resources.
videoModelLargeTurboDesc: Best speed/accuracy tradeoff. Recommended for GPU.
videoLanguageDesc: Language code (e.g. en, zh, ja). Leave empty for auto-detection.
videoTranslateDesc: Translate non-English speech to English during transcription
videoFrameExtractionDesc: Extract key frames for OCR text recognition (slides, whiteboards)
videoFrameIntervalDesc: Extract one frame every N seconds
videoPreferSubtitlesDesc: Use existing subtitles instead of re-transcribing
videoSceneThresholdDesc: Lower values capture more frames (more sensitive)
videoBeamSizeDesc: Higher values are more accurate but slower
videoDeleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the downloaded Whisper model? You will need to re-download it to use video transcription.
videoUnavailableRequires: Video analysis requires the video feature to be enabled at build time.
videoUnavailableRebuild: Rebuild with cargo build --features video to enable this feature.
deleteModelConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this model? You can re-download it later.
memoryDescription: Persistent notes stored on this device and injected progressively based on relevance.
memoryPlaceholder: Example: My preferred answer language is Chinese.
memoryCharHelper: {length}/{limit} chars. Keep each note short for lower token usage.
agentMemoryDescription: Reusable tool and workflow lessons recorded by the agent.
agentMemoryEmpty: No agent workflow memory saved yet.
appearance.theme.description: Choose a color theme for the interface
developerMode.description: Show internal runtime diagnostics and agent quality evaluation.
agentQualityDescription: Run local deterministic checks for routing, evidence policy, and checkpoint recovery.
agentQualityUnavailable: Run this local harness to verify agent behavior before shipping changes.
cacheTtlDesc: How long to cache AI answers. Set to 0 to disable caching.
searchLimitDesc: Maximum number of search results returned by default.
searchSimilarityDesc: Minimum similarity threshold for vector search results (0.0-1.0).
maxTextFileSizeDesc: Maximum file size for text document ingestion.
dynamicToolsDesc: Experimental prompt compaction: show only relevant tool schemas. Keep off for maximum reliability and prompt-cache stability.
traceEnabledDesc: Record detailed traces of agent interactions for debugging and optimization.
autoMemoryExtractionDesc: After successful conversations, extract concise reusable user memories in the background.
autoSkillLearningDesc: After successful complex turns, create reviewed skill proposals from reusable workflows without applying them automatically.
dreamingEnabledDesc: Prepare reviewed suggestions from local activity before anything is applied to memory or the graph.
dreamingIdleDesc: Run only when scans and agent tasks are not active.
dreamingAfterScanDesc: Create suggestions after new source compilation finishes.
dreamingAfterTurnDesc: Create suggestions after completed agent conversations.
dreamingScheduleDesc: Run at a fixed interval while the app is open.
dreamingMaxArtifactsDesc: Hard cap for one consolidation run.
confirmDestructiveDesc: Ask for confirmation before the agent edits files or removes sources.
toolApprovalDesc: Per-call confirmation for high-risk tools (shell, archive, destructive ops).
toolApprovalAskDesc: Prompt before each high-risk tool call (default).
toolApprovalAllowAllDesc: Skip approvals. Use only in trusted environments.
toolApprovalDenyAllDesc: Block every high-risk tool call silently.
toolAccessOverviewDesc: What the agent is allowed to ask for, shown before any specific approval prompt appears.
shellAccessModeDesc: Controls how much freedom run_shell gets. Restricted is safest; open gives the agent full command execution.
shellAccessRestrictedDesc: Whitelisted commands only, scoped to registered sources.
shellAccessConfirmAllDesc: Allow any bare command, but require confirmation before each run_shell call.
shellAccessOpenDesc: Allow any bare command with no confirmation. Use only if you trust the active agent and prompts.
textToSpeechDesc: Cloud speech synthesis for fast audio drafts, narration, and accessible read-aloud output.
ttsSherpaHint: Install with pip install sherpa-onnx, then select a downloaded TTS model package. The executable can be a PATH command or an absolute path.
imageGenerationDesc: Image provider defaults for generate_image. API keys can be shared with the same LLM provider.
modelSearchPlaceholder: Search models by name, provider, or ID
deleteProviderConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this provider? This cannot be undone.
noProvidersDesc: Add an AI provider to start using the chat assistant.
contextWindowHelp: Leave empty to auto-detect based on model name. Override if needed.
reasoningAlwaysOn: Reasoning is always on for this model.
thinkingBudgetHelp: Token budget for models that expose a thinking-token control.
reasoningEffortHelp: Available reasoning effort levels depend on the selected provider and model.
reasoningUnsupported: No configurable reasoning controls are available for this model.
maxIterationsHelp: Maximum number of tool-use round-trips per message. Leave empty for no tool-iteration cap. Set a number only when you want to bound a run.
summarizationHelp: Use a cheaper model for conversation summarization. If empty, the main model is used.
summarizationProviderHelp: Only change if the summarization model uses a different provider than the main model.
personasDescription: Create reusable local persona instructions and bind default skills.
deletePersonaConfirm: Deleting this custom persona will make conversations using it fall back to the default persona.
skillsDescription: Custom instructions to modify agent behavior
skillInstallDescription: Review a local skill package before adding its instructions and resources.
skillInstallFolderHint: Find one or more SKILL.md bundles
skillInstallReplaceDescription: Keep the existing IDs and replace the contents of: {{names}}
skillInstallRiskConfirm: I reviewed the blocked findings and still want to install this package.
skillInstallBuiltinConflict: These names belong to read-only built-in skills and cannot be replaced: {{names}}
skillDescriptionPlaceholder: Concise trigger description: when this skill should activate (keywords / user intents).
noSkills: No skills configured. Add a skill to customize agent behavior.
skillSearchPlaceholder: Search skills by name, description, or content…
skillProposalsDescription: Review agent-authored skill changes before they become active.
skillProposalApplyConfirmMessage: This will create or update the skill and affect future automatic skill selection.
skillProposalCurrentMissing: The current skill could not be found. The proposal content will be applied as-is.
skillNoResults: No skills match the current filter.
skillImportScanSubtitle: Review the findings below before importing this skill.
mcpServersDescription: Connect external tools through the Model Context Protocol
noMcpServers: No MCP connectors configured. Add a connector to extend agent capabilities.
mcpTransportHelp: Only transports that are implemented end-to-end are shown here.
mcpStdioHint: Launch a local MCP process such as `npx`, `uvx`, or `docker run`.
mcpStreamableHint: Recommended. Single HTTP endpoint with session-aware JSON or SSE responses.
mcpSseHint: Compatibility mode for older remote MCP endpoints that expose an SSE stream plus a message endpoint.
mcpUrlInvalid: URL must use http or https.
mcpArgsHelp: Recommended: use a JSON array. One-arg-per-line, comma-separated, and whitespace-separated input also work.
mcpEnvHelp: Use a JSON object. If `PORT` is omitted, the app injects `PORT=0` so the OS can assign a free port.
mcpUrlHelp: Enter the full MCP endpoint URL. `streamable_http` is typically something like `https://host/mcp`.
mcpHeadersHelp: Use a JSON object, for example `{"Authorization":"Bearer ..."}`.
mcpArgsInvalidArray: Arguments JSON must be an array of strings.
mcpJsonInvalidEntries: keys must be non-empty and values must be strings.
mcpDraftReady: This draft is ready to test and save.
mcpDraftInvalid: Fix the highlighted fields before testing or saving.
mcpFreePortManaged: If the command needs a port, the app can inject a free port automatically instead of failing on a busy default port.
mcpExplicitPort: You already set `PORT` explicitly, so the app will not override it.
mcpRemoteSessionNote: Remote transports keep custom headers and handle session ids; `streamable_http` will attempt to reinitialize when a session expires.
projectTools.title: Project tools
projectTools.description: Repository-declared shortcuts the agent can discover. Runs stay approval-gated and are bound to the exact manifest hash shown here.
projectTools.noTools: No project tools found in registered sources.
projectTools.invalidManifestsDesc: These files were found but cannot be used until the manifest is fixed.
projectTools.metadataWarning: This manifest is descriptive only and cannot be run.
projectTools.writeWarning: This tool declares write access and may modify source files.
discardTabChangesMessage: You have unsaved changes in this settings tab. Discard them and switch tabs?
discardPageChangesMessage: You have unsaved changes in Settings. Discard them and leave this page?
advancedSettingsDesc: Generation limits, cost controls, and delegated worker access.
subagentsDesc: Choose which delegated tools and enabled skills subagents may inherit, and set concurrency and budget limits for delegated workers and adjudicators.
maxParallelWorkersDesc: Hard cap on how many delegated workers may run at the same time.
maxWorkerCallsPerTurnDesc: Limits total delegated worker and judge invocations in one parent turn.
tokenBudgetPerTurnDesc: Soft total token budget for delegated workers and result adjudication.
delegatedSkillsDesc: Enabled global skills are inherited by default. Open this only when a provider needs a narrower skill set.
noEnabledSkillsToDelegate: No enabled skills are currently available to delegate.
personaDefaultInstructions: Balanced default behavior with no extra persona prompt.
documentToolsStatusUnchecked: Current document tools status has not been checked yet.
dreamingMaxRunsDesc: Manual runs are still available when this daily background budget is exhausted.
dreamingLocalOnlyDesc: Keep Dreaming suggestions grounded in local indexes and review artifacts. Future model-backed planners must honor this switch.
dreamingSourcesDesc: Leave empty to allow all sources; select sources to restrict Dreaming to those libraries.
dreamingProjectsDesc: Leave empty to allow all projects; select projects to restrict project-memory suggestions.
packageHost.title: Package Host
packageHost.description: Lifecycle and health state for built-in capability packages.
speechToTextDesc: Choose fast hosted transcription, existing local Whisper, or private sherpa-onnx SenseVoice and streaming Zipformer models for microphone input.
sttLocalWhisperHint: Local Whisper uses the model selected under Video & Audio. Hosted and sherpa-onnx options usually return short dictation much faster.
ttsAutoSpeakFinalDesc: After a turn completes, collapse the working trace and speak only the final answer. The chat header also provides a quick switch.
localModelStorageDesc: Choose where Nexa stores managed embedding, OCR, and Whisper downloads. The default location is shown and can be changed to another drive.
localModelStorageWarning: Changing the location does not move or delete existing model files. Downloads and delete actions use the newly selected folders.
localModelStorageUnavailable: Model settings are still loading. Try again in a moment.
localModelStorageSaveError: Failed to save the local model location
localSpeechModelsDesc: Configure private sherpa-onnx TTS and STT beside the other downloaded and local models. No API key is required.
providerCategorySpeechDesc: Text to speech and speech to text share this section. Cloud providers use an API key; on-device engines run locally from downloaded models.
speechProviderCatalogHint: Cloud providers call a hosted API with your key. On-device engines run locally once their model files are downloaded.
speechEnginesLinkDesc: Text to speech and speech to text are configured with the other providers. This card shows what is active right now.
whisperDictationActive: Dictation uses this local Whisper model, so downloading it here also updates speech to text.
whisperDictationInactive: Speech to text currently uses {engine}. This Whisper model is used for video and audio transcription only.
sharedCredentialAvailable: {provider} also stores a key for this endpoint
sharedCredentialDetectedDesc: No key is needed here. Leave the field empty to keep following that provider, or fill it in to override.
sharedCredentialAvailableDesc: This capability uses the key typed above. Clear it to follow the other provider again.
modelCatalogFallback: Live listing unavailable; using the curated fallback
ttsVoiceSearchPlaceholder: Search voices by name, ID, or language
ttsCustomVoiceId: Selected voice ID (editable for a custom voice)
